assumptions: the substrate executed the check as written (ASM-SUBSTRATE-INTEGRITY)
attrs.evidence: Every cell of the outcome table is exercised. Materials resolved: 0 with 25 registered mutations refused. A refused check: 1. Materials absent: 2. A pinned hash replaced with zeroes while the real artifact sits on disk: 2. --report-only with materials absent: 0, with no PASS verdict emitted — verified by grepping the output, where the only two occurrences of the token are a mutation id containing PASS and the sentence saying the mode never returns one. And the caller: with INV_MATERIALS unset the bundle build sets HERMETIC_FAIL=1 on exit 2. The extraction loop runs --report-only because an extraction cannot have the materials; the release path runs hard mode where they are.

coverage.domain: the three declared outcomes crossed with the two invocation modes
coverage.enumerator: the EXIT table the program reads, with each cell run

attrs.gap: THIS IS ONE VERIFIER. The general policy is FAC-NOT-STATED-NONPASSING and it is DECLARED, because fifteen other gates are two-valued and no census says which of them should not be. Second: the outcome is about what this program RETURNS, and only one caller is shown to consume it correctly.
attrs.prior_art: GPT-5.6’s INV-R9.3 audit §4, which found the universal wording contradicted by its own gap and asked for exactly this split.
attrs.review_focus: Does an exact-scope PROVED beside a DECLARED policy read as honest, or as a way to keep a green cell while the general claim retreats? It is the second time this round has made that trade.
attrs.statement: scripts/check-integration.mjs returns exactly three outcomes — 0 PASS, 1 FAIL, 2 NOT_STATED — a required material that is absent or hash-mismatched yields 2, --report-only never emits a PASS verdict, and the release caller refuses 2 exactly as it refuses 1.
